name: EAR YOGA
trialStarts: first launch on device; countdown preserved across updates
notes: Mobile release 1.50: enable flying note medallions 1,3,5,7 in Student, with real single-shot tones and existing capped score bonuses. Student retains four supplies; Teacher retains all twelve note variants and its existing oxygen rules. Both unlock after two fully solved chords, freeze on pause and clear for completed listening. RU/EN field guide explains each mode. Four persistent chakra proficiency ranks (red to green) and separate full-mandala medals are available in Settings and About. Three upper ranks remain reserved and unearnable. Independent answer accuracy, laps, route/key variety, complexity and unique note catches determine ranks; existing records stay intact. Compact completion award, original terrain, Hybrid Keys attack and musical voicings retained.
